verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Homebrew can install a Brewfile in CI such as GitHub Actions, downloads prebuilt bottles automatically, and can skip installation via `brew bundle check || brew bundle install`. None of this is a documented cache-restore setup or an offline-capable install mode. Bottles and bundle check are adjacent speed features, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can make CI installs fast with a documented cache-restore setup and offline-capable installs
